description: Figure 8 presents a comparison of accuracy during the Embedding and LM Head training stage for experiments Ex1 and Ex2. The x-axis is labeled “Step”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 60000, and has tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 0.80, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.10.  A blue solid line with circular markers represents Ex1 End Validation Loss, starting at approximately 0.76 at Step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.14 at Step 60000. A green dashed line with triangular markers represents Ex2 End Validation Loss, starting at approximately 0.78 at Step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.12 at Step 60000. A blue solid line with square markers represents Ex1 Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.16 at Step 0 and increasing to approximately 0.74 at Step 60000. A green dashed line with diamond markers represents Ex2 Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.14 at Step 0 and increasing to approximately 0.76 at Step 60000.
